english:
On Wednesday, Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 8 [g-k]: "God of our fathers" (Astuadz harts'n merots').
Midday Messedi Psalm 37 [38]: "Forsake me not" (Mi t'oghur zis).
Book of Exodus 2:11: "And it came to pass after those days..." to verse 22: "...in a foreign land."
Prophet Joel 2:1: "Blow the trumpet in Zion..." to verse 11: "...is sufficient for him."
Prophet Micah 4:1 [erroneously cited as 3:1]: "And it shall come to pass in the [latter] days..." to verse 7: "...even forever."
Psalm 56 [57]: "Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy" (Oghormia indz astuadz, oghormia), say in full.

On Thursday, Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 2 [a-k]: "Blessed and glorified" (Orhneal yev p'aravoreal).
Midday Messedi Psalm 70 [71]: "Cast me not off" (Mi ynkenur zis).
Book of 1 Samuel [1 Kings] 3:21: "And Eli was very old..." to 4:18: "...Israel twenty years."
Proverbs 3:11: "My son, do not despise..." to 4:14: "...into the path of the wicked."
Prophet Jeremiah 2:31: "Hear the word of the Lord..." to 3:16: "...shall be done in those days."
Psalm 142 [143]: "Lord, hear my prayer" (Ter lur aghot'its imots), say in full.

On Friday, Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 8 [g-k]: "Incomprehensible Essence" (Zanchar eut'iun).
Midday Messedi Psalm 118 [119]: "Let my cry come near" (Merdzestsin khndrvadzq).
Book of Deuteronomy 7:11: "And thou shalt keep the commandments..." to 8:1: "...which the Lord swore to our fathers."
Book of Job 9:1: "Truly I know..." to 10:2: "...do not teach me to be ungodly."
Prophet Isaiah 40:9: "Get thee up into the high mountain..." to verse 17: "...and they were counted as nothing to Him."
Psalm 64 [65]: "Hear us, O God" (Lur mez astuadz), say in full.

On Saturday, Feast of Saint Cyril, Patriarch of Jerusalem, and of the other Cyril, the bishop, and of his mother Anna.
Resurrection Hymn [ah.] Tone 7 [d-g]: [Hymns of] Martyrs.
Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 3 [d-k]: "Who participated" (Orq haghordets'an).
Youths Hymn [Mankunq] Tone 6 [g-d]: "Children of the New Zion" (Mankunq nor sioni).
Midday Psalm 131 [132]: "Thy priests" (Qahanayq k'o).
Proverbs 11:2: "The mouth of the humble..." to verse 11: "...by the mouth of the wicked it is overthrown."
Prophet Isaiah 61:3: "And they shall be called..." to verse 7: "...upon their heads."
Epistle 2 Timothy 4:1: "I charge thee..." to verse 8: "...His appearing."
Alleluia: "Priests."
Gospel John 10:11: "I am the good shepherd..." to verse 16: "...and one shepherd."
In the Evening, Hymn at Bowing [Hmb.] Tone 6 [g-k]: "We bless Thee" (Orhnemq zqez).

Third Sunday of Great Lent.
Resurrection Hymn [ah.] Tone 6 [g-k]: "We bless Thee" (Orhnemq zqez), with its canons [sarok'n].
Psalm 112 [113]: "Blessed be the name of the Lord."
Gospel Luke 6:12: "And it came to pass in those days..." to verse 49: "...the ruin of that house was great."
Midday Psalm 64 [65]: "Praise becometh Thee" (Qez vayele).
Prophet Isaiah 54:11: "Thus says the Lord: I am reconciled..." to 55:13: "...and it shall not fail."
Psalm 75 [76]: "Vow [and pay unto the Lord]" (Ukhts diq).
Epistle 2 Corinthians 6:1: "We then, as workers together with Him..." to 7:1 [erroneously cited as 6:18]: "...holiness in the fear of God."
Psalm: "Make a joyful noise unto the Lord."
Gospel Luke 15:1: "Then drew near unto Him..." to verse 32: "...was lost, and is found."

On Monday, Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 3 [b-dz]: "Blessed art Thou, Lord God" (Orhneal ter astuadz).
Midday Messedi Psalm 50 [51]: "Restore unto me, O Lord" (Dardzo zis ter).
Epistle Colossians 2:8: "Beware lest..." to 3:4: "...ye shall appear in glory."

On Tuesday, Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 3 [b-dz]: "Right are Thy ways" (Ughigh en chanaparhq k'o).
Midday Messedi Psalm 127 [128]: "Blessed is everyone" (Erani amenets'un).
Epistle Hebrews 11:1: "What is faith..." to verse 31: "...having received the spies with peace."

On Wednesday, Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 4 [b-k]: "Who [of our] fathers" (Or harts'n merots).
Midday Messedi Psalm 37 [38]: "Forsake me not" (Mi t'oghur zis).
Book of Exodus 2:23: "And it came to pass after those days..." to 3:15: "...and this is My memorial unto all generations."
Prophet Joel 2:21: "Fear not, O land..." to verse 32: "...shall call upon Him."
Psalm 70 [71]: "In Thee, O Lord, have I put my trust" (I k'ez ter yusats'ay), say in full.

On Thursday, Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 4 [b-k]: "The captive children" (Mankunqn gerealq).
Midday Messedi Psalm 70 [71]: "Cast me not off" (Mi ynkenur zis).
Prophet Isaiah 45:16: "Be renewed unto me..." to verse 26: "...of the children of Israel."
Epistle Ephesians 3:14: "For this cause I bow..." to 4:13: "...unto the fullness of Christ."

On Friday, Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 4 [b-k] of the Penitential: "Mighty God" (Astuadz hzor).
Midday Messedi Psalm 118 [119]: "Let my cry come near" (Merdzestsin khndrvadzq).
Book of Deuteronomy 8:11: "Beware that thou forget not..." to 9:10: "...in the day of the assembly [church]."
Book of Job 12:1: "No doubt but ye are people..." to 13:6: "...and hearken to the pleadings of my lips."
Prophet Isaiah 42:1: "Jacob my servant..." to verse 8: "...neither my praise to graven images."
Psalm 74 [75]: "We give thanks to Thee" (Khostovan yeghits'uq), say in full.

On Saturday, Feast of Saint John, Patriarch of Jerusalem, and of the holy Patriarchs.
